question: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
evidence: cards have missing or degraded properties and value refers to hasContentWarning = 1; 'Stephen Daniele' is artist; Find all cards refers to return card id
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
gold0: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

c.request:
Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
Evidence: cards have missing or degraded properties and value refers to hasContentWarning = 1; 'Stephen Daniele' is artist; Find all cards refers to return card id
Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
c.sql: SELECT c.id, r.text AS ruling_text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties, c.hasContentWarning FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

d.request: Find all cards illustrated by the artist "Stephen Daniele" (returning each card's id), and describe the text of the rulings for these cards, including cards that have no matching rulings record. Also state whether these cards have missing or degraded properties and values (i.e., whether hasContentWarning = 1).
d.sql: SELECT c.id, r.text AS ruling_text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

b.request: Find every card whose artist is Stephen Daniele, returning each card's id, its ruling text (left join so cards with no rulings are still included, with null ruling text), and whether hasContentWarning = 1 marks it as having missing or degraded properties
b.sql: SELECT c.id, r.text AS ruling_text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Has missing or degraded properties' ELSE 'No missing or degraded properties' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
